'''Corran Antillies Leia can be profitable''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Corran Antillies]]
* '''Published:''' 29 May 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif|label=You Can Either Profit By This...}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' You Can Either Profit By This...
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 Profit Antillies LS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Seeking An Audience (V), Civil Disorder (V), Princess Leia (V), Chewbacca (V), Rycar Ryjerd (V), Sai'torr Kal Fas (V), Leia's Sporting Blaster (V), Bionic Hand (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Introduction ==

Tries to be a speed profit, but drags the game out otherwise.

== Notes ==

* Han Solo is listed in Starting (captured under Profit) with 'I've been experimenting with various hans'; dested the printed Premiere Han Solo.
* Original-era (V) slips: Seeking An Audience (VS6), Civil Disorder (VS6), Princess Leia (VS6), Chewbacca (VS3), Rycar Ryjerd (VS2), Sai'torr Kal Fas (VS1), Leia's Sporting Blaster (VS3), Bionic Hand (VS6).
* Posted 'Owen and Beru' dested Owen Lars & Beru Lars; 'Jedi's Concentration' A Jedi's Concentration; 'Honor' Honor Of The Jedi; 'Padme' Padme Naberrie; 'Artoo' the Jabba's Palace Artoo.

== Strategy ==

First turn pull a DB and make sure Leia & her gun are there.  If they are, send her into the AC and take down one with the gun and one with the 2 destiny, making sure that you throw down whatever you get in your opening hand with her.  If this doesn’t take the AC, just keep sending in raids of whoever you can.  Pull all the effects you can.  CD V, Bacta tank, Ben, and Old ben should help you to just keep coming until your opponent eventually runs out of people.  There are a bunch of destiny adders, so use luke, leia, and lando to get rid of any character destiny limiters, and sense to cancle any interrupts.  Every turn pull a DB until all are on table.  When you flip, protect han obviously and spread out with one main per site.  Artoo can be pulled and can pull A gift.  3po can be pulled.  Artoo with a gift and 3po makes all oponent’s destinies where he has an alien -3.  That’s about it.

*Note I don’t use luke’s or annikan’s sabers, since I don’t have them nor do I have anything anyone who does have them wants.

*I switched Epp Han to Han Solo, because I forgot Epps couldn't be retrieved with CD V
